screen: Production public creator profile, personal viewer (desktop 1440), Stage 5 pass 1

expected_differences: This public creator profile was not drawn in the Lab. Its quieter identity, work, recorded facts and reviews layout should not reproduce the Lab discovery shelves or private-profile masthead.
Jasmine’s saved coffee-image avatar, name, Raleigh location and bio are record differences; do not substitute a fixture portrait.
Verified creator and Instagram confirmed manually by TapMart are legitimate recorded states, unlike the Lab’s unverified/manual fixture combination.
Two completed works, the actual portfolio sources, two reviews and zero TapMart followers/following correctly replace fixture content.
The Personal navigation, notification count and Follow/Report actions correctly reflect this viewer. Business-only Request Story and Request Reel actions should not appear.
Private earnings, payout information and vehicle inventory correctly do not belong in this public profile.
keep: The matching TapMart mark and wordmark, 200px graphite rail, 32px content inset, mineral canvas and shadow-free working regions.
Strong name and section typography, readable muted metadata, cobalt Follow and secondary ink Report.
The saved identity image without an invented replacement portrait or decorative cover.
Open work media at differing source ratios, attached captions and the distinction between Approved work and Portfolio.
Plain recorded facts and reviews with author, score and date; verification and Instagram provenance remain separately stated.
review.readiness_note: Hold this viewport for the public vehicle-field correction and media-radius cleanup. Navigation, Follow, Report, work and reviews remain visibly exposed; a capture cannot verify action handlers, destination routing or persistence.

drift.change: Remove the entire “Vehicle / None listed” row from the public Recorded section. Render only “Drives with TapMart” when the recorded public capability permits it; otherwise render no vehicle-related row. Do not derive public absence text from private vehicle inventory.
drift.why: The public-profile rule permits only Drives with TapMart, not vehicle inventory or its absence. “None listed” exposes an inventory-derived state and can misleadingly suggest the creator has no vehicle.
drift.where: Recorded section, final row beneath Instagram.

drift.change: Set the identity image and its clipping wrapper to border-radius: 4px instead of the visibly larger rounding. Set the supplied Story image and its clipping wrapper to border-radius: 0px. Preserve the existing sources, display sizes and source-ratio work layout.
drift.why: Frame Shift specifies 4px ordinary media corners and square supplied Story sheets. The rounded identity image and Story sheet soften the approved material distinction.
drift.where: Identity image at approximately x232/y44 and Story portfolio sheet at x512/y634.

review.why: The production screen largely carries the approved language: mineral canvas, graphite navigation, restrained borders, strong headings, operational metadata and a concentrated cobalt primary action. Work remains identifiable rather than being cropped into uniform cards, and the complete Story creative is visible. The source-and-caption relationships suit a public profile; adding a private masthead, vehicle assembly or payment ledge would be inappropriate. Recorded facts remain unboxed, review provenance is readable and no private money is shown. The concrete exceptions are the prohibited public vehicle-absence row and media corner treatments.
review.verdict: Frame Shift is largely transferred and personal-viewer functionality remains visible, but the public vehicle field and media-radius drift prevent release sign-off.
